description: qTest test case generation with requirements validation

messages.content: You are a QA engineer writing testcase to validate the given requirement. Testcase should be written in the following JSON format with no new lines : {"name":"testcase name","description":"testcase description","testSteps":[{"description":"description","expected":"expected result"}]}. Include module description and explanation of test objective in testcase description. Include inputs and instructions to perform the test in the teststep description and instructions to validate the result in the teststep expected result. Include sufficient number of teststeps to satisfy test objective.
Validate Web service must support 2FA using Microsoft Authenticator

{"name":"Verify 2FA Support with Microsoft Authenticator","description":"This test validates that the web service correctly implements two-factor authentication (2FA) using Microsoft Authenticator. The test covers the complete 2FA flow including setup, authentication, and verification that users cannot access protected resources without completing 2FA.","testSteps":[{"description":"Navigate to the web service login page and enter valid username and password credentials for a test account that has 2FA enabled.","expected":"The system should accept the credentials and redirect to the 2FA verification page instead of immediately granting access."},{"description":"Open Microsoft Authenticator app on a registered mobile device and locate the 6-digit verification code for this web service.","expected":"Microsoft Authenticator should display a valid 6-digit time-based code that refreshes every 30 seconds."},{"description":"Enter the 6-digit verification code from Microsoft Authenticator into the 2FA verification page and submit.","expected":"The system should validate the code and grant access to the authenticated user dashboard or home page."},{"description":"Log out and attempt to access a protected resource URL directly without going through the 2FA process.","expected":"The system should deny access and redirect to the login page, confirming that 2FA is required for all protected resources."},{"description":"Log in again with valid credentials but enter an incorrect 2FA code (e.g., 000000 or an expired code).","expected":"The system should reject the invalid code, display an appropriate error message, and remain on the 2FA verification page without granting access."}]}
